decisions.reason: As a multi-model safety shoe line with increased website visibility, it reflects substantial investment and public commitment, so management sticks with it.
This comfort insole received only brief website mentions, signaling low investment and no public commitment, making it easier to discontinue and redirect resources.
While minimally promoted, the supportive insole aligns with foot health and complements the flagship insole line, so management gives it more time.
The ergonomic safety shoe series has had dedicated web pages since launch, indicating high investment and visible commitment that justify persistence.
Firefighter and rescue boots are a specialized, high-stakes product line with growing web presence, so management is unlikely to abandon the investment.
As the publicly highlighted flagship with home-page placement and a demonstrated customer application, it is central to the firm's direction and cannot be dropped without large write-offs.
